o1: Enables DEAD/H-box RNA helicase binding activity; enables protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity. Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity. Involved in microtubule cytoskeleton organization; nuclear envelope organization; negative regulation of microtubule severing during mitosis; positive regulation of microtubule severing during meiosis; sarcomere organization; axon guidance; centriole replication; vulval induction; mitotic progression; and the cellular response to UV. Is located in axonal growth cone; centrosome; neuronal cell body; and meiotic spindle poles. Is part of protein phosphatase type 2A complex. Is expressed in coelomocyte; nervous system, including neurons; non-striated muscle, including body-wall muscle; rectal epithelium; and reproductive system. Is part of centriole assembly pathway; Ras/Raf/MEK/ERK signaling pathway. Interacts with GCK-1; FARL-11; CASH-1; CCM-3; SLMP-1; UNC-51; UNC-14; SAS-5; and SUR-6. Predicted to interact with PAA-1 and SUR-6. Orthologous to human PPP2CA (protein phosphatase 2 catalytic subunit alpha) and PPP2CB (protein phosphatase 2 catalytic subunit beta).
